mix_ratio: 1A:1B by mass or volume; follow current cure instructions
frame_bond_material: Smooth-On Sil-Poxy; qualify the actual cured silicone, printed frame and TPU joints
assembly: Cast the four compliant fitting bases from the retained R1 fit geometry; finish their upper surface on the supplied form.
Mount each lower column foil on its base or nail with the declared 50 µm insulating bond.
Register the measured pressure-film island and row foil on the forming mandrel; keep adhesive out of the active electrical contacts.
Install the separately cast cover and bond its peripheral foot to the fitting base or nail face.
The end port admits both foil necks. Seal around the static neck edges after assembly with a small qualified flexible bead, without wicking into the pressure film or bracing a free bend.
limits: Nominal plating allowance adds 6.4 µm to the active layer stack; delivered film and finish thicknesses require measurement.
TPU-layer heights are above the R1 smoothed datum. The variable fitting base below it is part of the assembly and is not included in that number.
The silicone foot and side wall are parallel mechanical load paths; edge response and force calibration must be measured.
The nominal geometry does not qualify adhesion, sealed-cavity effects, moisture, wear, dynamic bending or 20 N performance.
Static foil exits must be sealed and strain-relieved before moving-jaw tests.
